entry.title: Pont de Normandie
entry.note: The inspected aerial picture supports pale inverted-Y pylons, stay fans, thin blue-edged roadway and approach piers. Retained mapped outline and current standard PMTiles Pont de Normandie bridge roads confirm the main-span midpoint, southward native+X, longer northern approach, width and full crossing length. Mapped main spacing860m is close to source856m and total2141m. A deliberately approximate-4.4m translation adapts the legacy CMH-authored height to a global sea-plane visualization; this is not a certified IGN69/EGM/tidal conversion. Bounded pylon/pier bases extend below the working water plane; mapped PMTiles water masks form the preview shoreline and raw surrounding terrain is retained. Approach road heights remain source reconstructions, with connected host road fitting requested. Preview places the authored base at the recorded absolute sea-level elevation; local tide and terrain resolution remain host-dependent.

review: Explicit authoring proposal; registration is not geographic or maximum-fidelity approval.
